legal.title: Terms & safety
legal.summary: Manual timers. You operate and check your appliances.
legal.scope.title: What DONE does
legal.scope.body: DONE records the appliances, programs and times you enter. It does not connect to appliances, access their sensors or detect their actual state. Start, stop and Siri commands in DONE affect only the app timer; they do not turn an appliance on or off.
legal.safety.title: Use appliances safely
legal.safety.body: Operate and check the physical appliance yourself and follow its manufacturer’s instructions. DONE is not a safety device, monitoring service or emergency alarm. Never rely on it to supervise cooking, heat, gas or other hazards; do not leave equipment unattended where supervision is required.
legal.alerts.title: Times & reminders
legal.alerts.body: Durations, progress and completion alerts are estimates based on your entries. A timer ending does not prove the appliance has finished. Notifications, widgets, Live Activities and synchronization may be delayed, unavailable or interrupted by permissions, Focus, connectivity or system settings. Always verify the appliance yourself.
legal.sharing.title: Shared links
legal.sharing.body: Anyone with a shared link can view the status shown in it and forward the link. Avoid personal information in appliance and program names. Shared status reflects app records, may be delayed and does not certify the physical appliance’s state. Revoke a link when you no longer want to share it.
legal.rights.title: Your rights
legal.rights.body: These explanations describe the service’s limits and do not remove statutory consumer rights or responsibilities imposed by applicable law. DONE does not guarantee uninterrupted service or the accuracy of user-entered information. Contact support about problems; privacy and account deletion are available separately.

legal.applePrivacy: If you use Sign in with Apple, DONE processes the Apple account identifier, the name and email you authorize Apple to share (which may be a private relay address), and authentication tokens. The backend verifies Apple credentials and encrypts the stored refresh token for revocation on account deletion. Your Apple password is never received by DONE.
